description:
A beautiful girl decides to go to school dressed as a boy in order to avoid unwanted attention from guys, only to come across a guy saying he’s her husband from the future and he’s there to protect her; and while it all seems unlikely, things start to change when he saves her time and again from unknown accidents.

Yoo Min, a high school student who suffers from unwanted male attention due to trauma after being kidnapped as a child, decides to to school dressed as a boy in order to overcome it. Although there are side effects to this approach, she has now become popular with women! At the school, male students no longer approach Yoo Min, who trained in martial arts, and has finally gotten a comfortable school life.

One day, a man named Na Yeon-woo dressed in dirty clothes appears in front of the school and claims to be Yoo Min’s husband from the future. Yoo Min keeps avoiding suspicions from other students, but Yeon-woo then stops her from getting on the subway one day, saying that it will be derailed. Yoo Min takes the subway in defiance of Yeon-woo and is totally surprised when the real derailment occurrs, and yet thanks to Yeon-woo, who rode along unknowingly, saves her. Yoo Min can no longer ignore Yeon-woo, and even finds out that he has a small diary from the future. This leads Yoo Min to believe that Yeon-woo is telling the truth, and discovers that the date of his diary has been cut off, but not before finding out that she is about to die. Yeon-woo actually came to the past from the future to save her and after learning about it, and Yeon-woo tries to prevent Yoo Min’s death by using his diary.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4300920), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54219481)
